tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzim 'od rjes sgrub 'jam dbyangs kyi 'dod gsol// dbu gzungs gras/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rjes su bzung du gsol/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam grub kun dga' mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i༞ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i༞ rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma'i༞ brag rtsa rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i༞ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas ye shes kyi༞ grub dbang blo gros dbang phyug gi༞ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal po'i༞ rje byams pa rab brtan bzang po'i༞ rje bsod nams blo gros kyi༞ 'jam mgon dpal ldan chos skyong gi༞ mkhan chen dbang phyug phun tshogs kyi༞ mkhan chen kun dga' zla 'od kyi༞ zhes 'od zer de'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan dang / thugs ka dang / bum ldir/ 'dod gsol ni dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang dbyer med brgyud pa'i bla ma kun gyi ngo bo lhag pa'i lha mchog rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / khro bo'i rgyal po dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed rnam gnyis kyis gtso mdzad yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pas rten 'di nyid rgyal kun mkhyen rab kyi ngo bo 'phags pa sku 'jam pa'i dpal/ gsung 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ thugs 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i bdag nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byin gyis brlabs nas kyang tshe las 'das pa bsod nams 'od zer gyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba mtshams med lnga de dang nye ba lnga/

mi dge bcu sogs mdor na 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu mtho ris dang thar pa sgrub pa'i gegs sdig sgrib nyes ltung bgyis dang bgyid bstsal rjes su yid rang ba sogs kyis bag med du bsags pa rnams myur du ma lus byang zhing dag nas bar do'i 'jigs skrag dang bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul thams cad las shin tu 'das nas mtho ris lha dang mi'i rten thob pa'am sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma bzhugs pa'i dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams myul nas skyabs mchog rnams kyi zhal mthong zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi myong ba'i skal ba can du gyur nas sa dang lam gyi yon tan mngon du gyur te rang don mthar phyin pa dang gzhan don gang la gang 'dul gyi go 'phang thob nas 'brel tshad don ldan ring por mi thogs par 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs kun 'gro la rjes chags thugs rje dang / /ngag dbang kun blo bdag gi lhag bsam dang / /tshe 'das bsod nams 'od zer dge stobs kyis/ /ji ltar smon pa de bzhin myur 'grub shog /ces dang / /mchod rten 'dod gsol dus gsum skyabs gnas nas/ lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rten 'di nyid bar gong bzhin la bde bar gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku zab cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba mtshon byed chos sku'i rten mngon par byang chub pa'i mchod rten du byin gyis brlabs tu gsol man 'dra/ 'gro mgon dpon slob gshegs po de'i nang rten gu ru rin che'i sku la dus gsum skyabs gnas nas kun gyi ngo bo bar gong bzhin sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi rang bzhin ma hā gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan zhing 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag bod gangs can gyi mgon po gang de'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi nas brlabs nas kyang bar gong bzhin/ tshe las 'das pa bstan pa sangs rgyas kyi tshe sogs nas ming bsgyur ma gtogs gong bzhin mchod rten 'dod gsol yang gong bzhin la ming bsgyur rigs 'gre'o/

/zhes rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing rta lo kho bos zhang chung bstan pa sangs rgyas dang / zla bo gzim dpon bsod nams 'od zer zhes rje btsun sa skya pa'i zhabs phyi la med mi rung lta bu de 'das pa'i rjes sgrub rten bzhengs skabs 'dod gsol du sa skya pa kun blos bris/ zla 3tshes 11la// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gzim 'od rjes sgrub 'jam dbyangs kyi 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
